title: The Dabbling Duck Charters

services.name: Dabbling Duck Charters 1
services.desc: Absolutely NO glass is permitted on board, protecting both our boat and the water. All guests under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. All guests 12 years or younger are required by Tennessee law to wear a Coast Guard-approved life jacket at all times. Life jackets will be provided. Appropriate swimwear is required on the boat too. No obscene or inappropriate clothing or behavior will be tolerated. The Dabbling Duck Boat Charters LLC offers a family-friendly experience. No flip flops, sandals, or open toed shoes!
